author: Binay Verma
status: Registered before any Stage A forecast for event years 2022-2023 and before parameter selection for those years. Event years 2024-2025 and their arms were already inspected; 2022-2023 are new to every model and arm.
question: Is the typed-minus-pooled ordering stable across four event years (2022-2025) and 20 family-year clusters?
conventions: first Diwali anchor = national main date; second = state-listed second Diwali holiday
festivals omitted from a state list only because of a weekend stay flagged
ordinary weekday fallback: next weekday when the requested weekday has no eligible date
sensitivities: new years only (2022-2023) versus old years only (2024-2025)
recorded_not_run: Karnataka 2021 state-listed Diwali 2021-11-03 versus national 2021-11-04 (sensitivity_state_listed_diwali.csv); it affects only a training-context year
primary: typed minus pooled balanced event MASE at lead 1, day and window representations, for the four local specifications (8 cells); exact sign-flip over 20 family-year clusters, Holm across the 8 cells, alpha 0.05
secondary: all 24 local cells (leads 1/7/14); sign by year (4 years) and leave-one-family-out; placebo and zero controls; ordinary-day costs; decision rules (follow previous-year winner, equal-weight average) for 2023-2025
interpretation: An ordering is called supported only if Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 and its sign holds in at least 3 of 4 years; otherwise not established. Not detected is not equivalence. Retrospective; calendars checked by a person.
